chat.settings.title: Assistant settings
chat.privacy.openrouterNote:
Your question and the selected study text are sent from this browser to OpenRouter, which forwards them to the model you choose. This app requests zero data retention and excludes upstream endpoints that may collect or train on the request. A model that cannot satisfy those controls will refuse the request rather than run with weaker privacy.

OpenRouter's own optional Input/Output Logging and use-of-prompts settings belong to your account or workspace. This app cannot see or change them. Text marked "no training" stays blocked unless you confirm those options are off for this session.

OpenRouter may anonymously categorize a small sample of prompts under a zero-retention policy. You must have the rights needed to send your question and any notes you select. Imported study works are included only when their recorded licence policy permits it.

Use your own eligible OpenRouter account and a dedicated key with a spend limit. OpenRouter and the selected model have their own terms, and OpenRouter may require purchased credits. This app does not accept Google, Anthropic, OpenAI, or other upstream-provider keys. If you configured provider BYOK separately in OpenRouter, those provider terms remain your responsibility.

Your key, question, and chat history are never sent to this Bible app's server.
